title: On Federated Averaging with Partial Participation under a General Variance Condition
abstract: arXiv:2611.14239v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In this paper, we study the convergence of Federated Averaging (FedAvg) with partial participation under a general variance condition. In each communication round, the server samples $S$ of the $n$ clients uniformly at random without replacement. The stochastic gradients are assumed to satisfy the so-called ABC condition, which allows their variance to grow with the local objective gaps. For smooth nonconvex objectives, we establish a finite-time stationarity bound in terms of the heterogeneity measure $\sigma_f^\star:=f^\star-\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^n f_i^\star$ and the client sampling factor $I_S:=(n-S)/(n-1)$. Here, $f^\star$ and $f_i^\star$ denote the infima of the global average objective and client $i$'s local objective, respectively. The bound exhibits a linear speedup in the number of sampled clients $S$ and recovers the full-participation result when $S=n$. translated_title: 关于一般方差条件下部分参与的联邦平均算法的研究
translated_abstract: 本文研究了在一般方差条件下具有部分客户端参与的联邦平均算法的收敛性。在每一通信轮次中，服务器从 n 个客户端中无放回地均匀随机抽取 S 个客户端。假设随机梯度满足所谓的 ABC 条件，该条件允许梯度方差随局部目标差距而增长。对于光滑非凸目标函数，我们建立了以异质性度量 σ_f* := f* − (1/n)Σf_i* 和客户端采样因子 I_S := (n−S)/(n−1) 表示的有限时间平稳性界，其中 f* 和 f_i* 分别表示全局平均目标和客户端 i 的局部目标的下确界。该界在采样客户端数量 S 上呈现线性加速，且当 S=n 时可恢复全参与情形的结果。在递减步长条件下，我们进一步证明了梯度范数……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文在允许方差随局部目标差距增长的一般方差条件（ABC条件）下，为部分客户端参与的联邦平均算法建立了包含异质性度量的有限时间平稳性收敛界，实现了随采样客户端数量的线性加速，并在全参与情形下与已有结果一致。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes finite-time stationarity bounds for Federated Averaging with partial client participation under the general ABC variance condition, achieving linear speedup in the number of sampled clients and recovering the full-participation result when S=n.
